name: io.github.AbhijatSaxena/uvc-ptz-camera-mcp
title: UVC PTZ Camera
description: Control a USB (UVC) pan/tilt/zoom camera: aim, nudge, sweep, zoom, and capture, with every move confirmed from the picture.

environmentVariables.name: UVC_PTZ_STATE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where to store what has been learned about each camera (its recorded directions and verification threshold). Defaults to ~/.uvc-ptz-camera-mcp. Holds angles, never credentials.

environmentVariables.name: UVC_PTZ_SIM_SOURCE
environmentVariables.description: Path to an image to use as the simulator's panorama, instead of the synthesised one. Useful for making a simulated run look like the real scene.
